Flyers' Dan Vladar: First goalie off Monday By RotoWire Staff Apr 13, 2026 at 11:08 am ET • 1 min read Learn More Now Playing Bruins Even Series With Sabres After 4-2 Win (0:45) Share Share Video Link copied! Vladar was the first goalie to exit the ice ahead of Monday's home game against the Hurricanes, Jordan Hall of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.Vladar will make his sixth straight appearance in the crease, having gone 4-1-0 with a 1.80 GAA in his previous five outings. As long as the Flyers are fighting for a playoff spot, fantasy managers can expect to see Vladar guarding the cage, which includes possibly taking both ends of Philadelphia's back-to-back and playing Tuesday at home versus Montreal.
